name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.RingGGH15.module_adjugate_break
title: Module adjugate break: with z0 = det S1 (u adj S0) and z1 = det S0 (u adj S1), z0·(S0 a + e0) - z1·(S1 a + e1) = z0·e0 - z1·e1 for k x k matrices over a commutative ring
statement: For a commutative ring R, a finite type k, S0 S1 : Matrix k k R and u a e0 e1 : k → R, with z0 = S1.det • (u ᵥ* S0.adjugate) and z1 = S0.det • (u ᵥ* S1.adjugate): z0 ⬝ᵥ (S0 *ᵥ a + e0) - z1 ⬝ᵥ (S1 *ᵥ a + e1) = z0 ⬝ᵥ e0 - z1 ⬝ᵥ e1.
